title: China Launches Major Financial Support Plan to Boost Economy
subtitle: Beijing injects billions into banks and insurers to fight slow growth and strengthen the financial system.

summary.en: China is moving forward with a massive financial support plan worth $54 billion. This effort aims to help banks and insurance companies manage risks and increase lending. The government hopes these funds will help the economy recover from a period of weak growth. State-owned institutions are providing the capital to ensure these companies remain stable. This move follows earlier efforts to support the country's financial sector during a difficult economic time.
summary.zh: 中國正推動一項價值五百四十億美元的大規模金融支持計畫。此舉旨在協助銀行與保險公司管理風險並增加放貸。政府希望這些資金能幫助經濟從成長疲軟的時期中復甦。國有機構正提供資本以確保這些公司保持穩定。此舉延續了先前在艱困經濟時期支持國內金融部門的努力。

paragraphs.en: China has announced a major plan to inject $54 billion into its financial sector. This effort is part of a broader attempt by Beijing to support banks and insurance companies as the country faces a period of slow economic growth. According to The Guardian, this move is designed to help these institutions invest in the stock market and provide more loans to businesses that need money to grow.
paragraphs.zh: 中國宣布了一項重大計畫，將向其金融部門注資五百四十億美元。這項舉措是北京當局為了在國家面臨經濟成長放緩之際，支持銀行與保險公司所做出的廣泛嘗試。根據《衛報 (The Guardian)》報導，此舉旨在協助這些機構投資股市，並為需要資金以求成長的企業提供更多貸款。

paragraphs.en: This new support comes at a time when global markets are already feeling nervous. As reported in recent updates, global bond markets—where governments and companies borrow money—are currently facing significant instability. Investors around the world are worried about rising government debt and the impact of higher oil prices on inflation. Against this difficult global background, Beijing is using this stimulus to make sure its own financial system stays strong.
paragraphs.zh: 這項新的支持措施出台之際，全球市場已顯得人心惶惶。根據近期的更新報導，全球債券市場（即政府與企業借貸資金的市場）目前正面臨顯著的不穩定。全球投資人對於政府債務攀升，以及油價上漲對通貨膨脹造成的影響感到擔憂。在如此艱困的全球背景下，北京正利用這項刺激方案，確保其國內金融體系保持穩健。

paragraphs.en: The plan involves several of China’s largest financial institutions. For example, China Life Insurance, the country’s biggest life insurer, will receive 35 billion yuan. Another group, China Taiping Insurance, is set to receive 7 billion yuan. Meanwhile, the People’s Insurance Company of China plans to raise 15 billion yuan by selling new shares directly to the ministry of finance. These actions are intended to help these companies manage their risks and improve their financial health, which has been hurt by low interest rates.
paragraphs.zh: 該計畫涉及中國多家大型金融機構。例如，中國最大的壽險公司「中國人壽」將獲得三百五十億人民幣。另一家集團「中國太平保險」預計將獲得七十億人民幣。同時，「中國人民保險」計畫透過直接向財政部出售新股，籌集一百五十億人民幣。這些行動旨在協助這些公司管理風險並改善財務狀況，因為這些公司的財務狀況已受到低利率的損害。

paragraphs.en: In addition to insurers, the country’s largest state banks are also getting help. On Sunday, three major lenders announced they would receive a combined 290 billion yuan in new capital. The Agricultural Bank of China and the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China are among those receiving funds. These banks plan to use the money to replenish their cash reserves. This will allow them to keep lending money to businesses, even though there is currently weak demand for new loans across the country.
paragraphs.zh: 除了保險公司之外，中國最大的國有銀行也獲得了援助。週日，三家主要放款機構宣布將獲得總計二千九百億人民幣的新資本。中國農業銀行與中國工商銀行皆在獲得資金的行列中。這些銀行計畫利用這筆資金補充現金儲備。儘管目前全國對新貸款的需求疲軟，這仍將使它們能夠持續向企業放貸。

paragraphs.en: This initiative is not entirely new. The plan was first discussed at an annual parliamentary meeting in March. It builds on a similar financing tool that was used to help big state banks last year. By providing this capital, the government hopes to strengthen the ability of these banks to support the "real economy." This term refers to the part of the economy that produces goods and services, rather than just financial trading. As China Life stated, this injection is an important step to promote high-quality development and help the industry withstand future risks.
paragraphs.zh: 這項倡議並非全然創新。該計畫最初是在三月份的年度全國人大會議上進行討論的。它是建立在去年用於協助大型國有銀行的類似融資工具之上。透過提供這些資本，政府希望增強這些銀行支持「實體經濟」的能力。該術語指的是生產商品與服務的經濟部門，而非單純的金融交易。正如中國人壽所言，此次注資是促進高品質發展並協助產業抵禦未來風險的重要一步。

paragraphs.en: There are several reasons why this support is necessary. Many insurance companies have been struggling with low profitability for some time. When interest rates stay low for a long period, it becomes harder for these companies to make money. As a result, many small and mid-sized insurers have seen their solvency ratios—a key measure of whether a company has enough money to pay its debts—get worse. By providing fresh capital, the government hopes to prevent these smaller, higher-risk companies from failing and to give larger firms more power to manage the market.
paragraphs.zh: 這項支持措施之所以必要，有幾個原因。許多保險公司長期以來一直苦於獲利能力低落。當利率長期維持在低檔時，這些公司要賺錢就變得更加困難。結果，許多中小型保險公司的償付能力比率（衡量公司是否有足夠資金償還債務的關鍵指標）皆出現惡化。透過提供新資本，政府希望防止這些規模較小、風險較高的公司倒閉，並賦予大型企業更多管理市場的能力。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, Beijing has been directing state insurers to support the stock market using medium- and long-term funds. By giving these companies more money, the government is making it easier for them to follow these directions. This strategy shows how the state is using its influence to keep the financial sector stable while trying to encourage growth in a challenging environment.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，北京一直指導國有保險公司利用中長期資金支持股市。透過給予這些公司更多資金，政府使其更容易遵循這些指示。這項策略顯示出國家如何利用其影響力來維持金融部門的穩定，同時試圖在充滿挑戰的環境中鼓勵成長。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the success of this stimulus will depend on whether businesses feel confident enough to borrow and invest. While the government is providing the necessary cash, the overall demand for loans remains low. Analysts will be watching closely to see if this large injection of money is enough to turn the tide for the world’s second-largest economy. For now, the focus remains on ensuring that the financial system has the strength to support the country through these uncertain times.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，這項刺激措施的成功與否，將取決於企業是否有足夠的信心進行借貸與投資。雖然政府提供了必要的現金，但整體貸款需求依然低迷。分析師將密切觀察這筆鉅額注資是否足以扭轉這個全球第二大經濟體的頹勢。目前，重點仍放在確保金融體系具備足夠的實力，以支持國家度過這些不確定的時期。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To put a large amount of money into a business or system to help it function.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於醫學（注射），這裡比喻為經濟注入資金。文中：China has announced a major plan to inject $54 billion into its financial sector.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fill something up again after it has been used or emptied.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞在商業語境中指恢復資金或庫存水位。文中：These banks plan to use the money to replenish their cash reserves.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cause a reversal in the direction of events, especially to change a bad situation into a good one.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意為「轉動潮汐」，引申為改變趨勢。文中：Analysts will be watching closely to see if this large injection of money is enough to turn the tide for the world’s second-largest economy.

quiz.question: How do the state banks intend to utilize the new capital they are receiving?

options.A: To pay off government debts and reduce inflation.
options.B: To replenish their cash reserves and maintain lending capacity.
options.C: To invest exclusively in the global bond market.
options.D: To increase interest rates for small and mid-sized businesses.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段，銀行獲得資金的主要目的是「replenish their cash reserves」（補充現金儲備），並確保即便在貸款需求疲軟的情況下，仍能持續提供企業貸款。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章未提到用來償還政府債務；選項 C 錯誤，文中提到的是投資股市而非全球債券市場；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未提到調升利率，反而是提到低利率環境帶來的挑戰。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the current state of the Chinese insurance industry?

options.A: It is growing rapidly due to high interest rates.
options.B: It is currently completely independent of government financial influence.
options.C: It is facing financial pressure that threatens its ability to meet debt obligations.
options.D: It has successfully avoided all risks associated with the stock market.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第六段，許多保險公司長期面臨低獲利，導致「solvency ratios」（償付能力比率）惡化，即難以支付債務。這顯示出其財務健康狀況堪憂。選項 A 與文意相反，因為文中強調的是低利率帶來的困境；選項 B 錯誤，文章明確提到政府正在引導保險公司行為並提供資金；選項 D 錯誤，文章指出政府正鼓勵這些公司投入股市，並非避開風險。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'turn the tide' mean in the context of China's economy?

options.A: To reverse a negative trend and improve the situation.
options.B: To increase the speed of global trade.
options.C: To destroy the existing financial infrastructure.
options.D: To measure the exact amount of government debt.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。片語「turn the tide」意指扭轉局勢。在文中，作者討論的是中國經濟面臨成長緩慢的挑戰，因此這項刺激計畫的目標是希望藉由注入資金，將經濟從低迷的狀態轉向好轉。選項 B 無關；選項 C 與文意完全相反，政府是為了穩定金融體系而非摧毀；選項 D 則與該片語的慣用語義不符。

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of the Chinese government's $54 billion financial injection?

options.A: To replace all private banks with state-owned institutions.
options.B: To profit from the global bond market instability.
options.C: To stabilize the financial sector and encourage economic growth despite challenges.
options.D: To force all businesses to stop borrowing money during the crisis.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章開頭與後續段落多次提到，這項計畫是為了支持銀行與保險公司，應對經濟成長放緩的壓力，並確保金融體系在動盪的全球環境下保持強健，進而支持「實體經濟」。選項 A 過於誇大，文中並無此意；選項 B 錯誤，政府是為了防禦而非獲利；選項 D 錯誤，政府的目標是確保銀行有能力持續提供貸款，而非阻止企業借貸。
